protocol.target: First recorded tracked item purchased after 10:00 and through 30:00
protocol.population: one player; only matches with an observed target purchase
protocol.features: hero, patch, LH/gold/XP at exactly 10:00; history variant adds purchases at time<=600
protocol.split: last 20% by match start time is the legacy test; same timestamps stay together
protocol.validation: expanding windows: first 50% -> next 25%, first 75% -> last 25% of development
protocol.selection: highest pooled validation accuracy, then lowest log-loss, then recipe name
protocol.test_status: previously reported benchmark, not a newly sealed holdout

limitations: The final 20% was reported before this experiment: it is not a sealed holdout.
A 100-match, single-player sample cannot establish performance for all five roles.
Macro F1 covers the union of observed and predicted labels in each scoring set.
Probability calibration estimates are descriptive on this small sample.
Prediction imitates a recorded purchase; no causal optimal-item label is available.
Matches without a target purchase in the window are excluded; coverage is conditional.
reproducibility_notes: The original Archive.rows() joins patch_version by release date. The first export omitted this join, making original-softmax accuracy 50%. The export was corrected with the unchanged original release table; original-softmax now reproduces the saved 60% exactly. Candidate recipes were unchanged.
